articles.title: Crypto vault deposits top $10 billion as lending risks draw regulatory scrutiny
articles.description: Curator-managed lending strategies are attracting institutional capital, while exposing depositors to collateral, liquidity and smart-contract risks.

articles.title: CME’s bitcoin cash, uniswap futures, global PMIs: Crypto Week Ahead
articles.description: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 19.

articles.title: Bitcoin whale moves $34 million in BTC it got in 2013 when coins traded at $131
articles.description: A bitcoin wallet dormant since 2013 moved 411 BTC, now worth about $34 million. It is one of several long-dormant wallets to wake up recently.

articles.title: Zcash developers plan a fix to keep ZEC swaps private from future quantum computers
articles.description: The team behind Zakura wants every swap through NEAR Intents to get its own key, so a refund address left on NEAR’s public chain can’t expose a user’s wider payment history.

articles.title: XRP Ledger is set to fix its lending code before anyone can use it
articles.description: Validators have a bug-fix patch on course to go live Friday. The lending system it partly repairs is still 10 votes short of approval.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Korea’s Kospi and Nasdaq futures rally as China GDP beats estimates
articles.description: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures and Asian stocks rally as stronger-than-expected China GDP and falling oil prices lift risk appetite.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
articles.description: The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.

articles.title: SEC tokenized stock framework faces issuer pushback as Broadcom, Verizon object to OKX-ICE listing
articles.description: Eight more companies objected to trading on the planned OKX-ICE venue, while Nasdaq has separately said it would opt out under the SEC’s framework.

articles.title: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto
articles.description: Patrick Witt announced his departure from the White House last week.

articles.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday, but VIX and bitcoin trades say the fear may fade Monday.
articles.description: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin markets suggest the same.

articles.title: Latvia eyes crypto tax payments in 2027 as parliament overhauls crypto taxation
articles.description: Parliament passed a law taxing crypto withdrawals above deposits rather than individual trades, featuring a one-time declaration mechanism.

articles.title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
articles.description: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s $100,000 year-end hope divides analysts as inflation clouds outlook
articles.description: Bitwise sees a potential return above $100,000, while LO:TECH expects a narrower trading range as interest-rate uncertainty weighs on the market.

articles.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
articles.description: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.

articles.title: Crypto exchanges Binance, Coinbase join West Africa scam sweep that flagged $11 million
articles.description: Private-sector partners flagged $11 million in funds that could be frozen, while officials reported cryptocurrency seizures without disclosing their value.

articles.title: Chip-stock bets lost $52 million in 10 minutes with Wall Street shut
articles.description: A 10-minute flush hit round-the-clock chip-stock contracts while U.S. markets were shut, leaving traders with no real share price to lean on.

articles.title: Circle defends USDC economics as stablecoin rivals court its partners with bigger cut
articles.description: Coinbase, Circle’s largest USDC partner, also backs Open USD, a rival network that passes reserve income to partners after a management fee.

articles.title: Goldman, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley see tokenization as a growth play, not a threat
articles.description: The largest banks in the world are eyeing new trading opportunities, speeding up payments and a role for advisers as tokenization takes root in Wall Street.

articles.title: Citrini sees a tokenization boom. The harder question is who profits
articles.description: The influential research firm says real-world assets could finally give blockchains a clear role in finance. For investors, the next challenge is figuring out which companies, networks and protocols capture the revenue.

articles.title: Polygon sees Coinme acquisition as entry to payments sector dominated by Visa, Stripe
articles.description: CEO Marc Boiron said the Coinme acquisition will help Polygon control customer relationships and capture revenue that previously went to payment intermediaries.

articles.title: Banks could slow stablecoin growth by paying savers more, BIS paper finds
articles.description: A BIS working paper found a 1 basis point rise in U.S. bank deposit rates predicted slower stablecoin growth, cutting ten-week growth from 15% to 12%.

articles.title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
articles.description: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.

articles.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google’s new Willow breakthrough
articles.description: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.

articles.title: Big Tech's AI auditors will only see what they're shown
articles.description: If the White House accord's audits are going to be worth anything, auditors should be able to choose what they test, writes Samuel Vance-Law, head of research at the Decentralization Research Center.

articles.title: Traders will soon be able to bet on whether Coinbase, Robinhood and Marathon will hit their targets
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 16, 2026
